style: Courtside, not corporate. Flat, confident, athletic energy over live volleyball footage. Yellow-on-transparent with a flat dark offset shadow, no soft glows or hairlines: legibility over unpredictable video is the constraint. Wordmark only. The play mark is never inside the d, and the symbol and the wordmark+symbol lockup are still open gates in forge-brand, so this sting carries no play mark (nino, 2026-10-12).
font: Peridot PE 950 (the locked wordmark), shipped as PNG letter layers; no live text in the composition

customize.why_hand_authored: Hand-authored. The 2026-07 version re-sequenced logo-outro around a play triangle nested in the d; that construction is ruled out, and per-letter layers need no catalog block.

content.layout: Wordmark centred in the 1080x1920 frame as a horizontal band: 800 px wide (74% of the frame, inside the overlay kit's validated x 122-940 safe area), about 195 px tall at Peridot's ~4.1:1, optical centre at 46% of the frame height (y ~883). The vertical negative space is intentional: it is a transparent overlay and the compositor owns placement. Each letter is a PNG layer sharing the full mark's box and scales about its own ink centre (origins in assets/wordmark/layers.js).
content.motif: Letter cascade. The word builds left to right the way it reads, holds flat, and clears left to right the way it arrived. One motion idea, no symbol.

motion.letter_build: per letter, stagger 0.06s from 0.15s: scale 0 -> 1 (power3.out, never past 1), y +36 -> 0 (back.out(2.2)), opacity 0 -> 1 (power2.out, 0.3s). The snap lives on the vertical lift: any scale overshoot fuses the tight k|d and d|a pairs of the heavy face.
motion.hold: static, flat, legible: the money frame for compositing. No ambient motion.
motion.letter_retract: per letter, stagger 0.05s from 3.85s: scale 1 -> 0 and opacity 1 -> 0 (power2.in, 0.44s), left to right.

beat_table.motion: staggered grow + lift, left to right
staggered collapse + fade, left to right
canvas fully empty; guarantees a clear final frame for CapCut

build_notes: The wordmark is Peridot PE 950, lowercase, standard cut, as eight registered PNG layers from scripts/build-sting-wordmark.mjs (run from the repo root; needs network for the Adobe Fonts kit and ImageMagick). Each layer is the full mark's canvas with one letter's ink; stacked they redraw the one-piece mark, and the script refuses to write layers that do not.
PNG, not SVG or live text: Peridot is licensed for live text, not for embedded outlines (BRAND-PRIORS.md), and the PNG layers keep the render free of any font kit.
Layers are drawn at 1600 px, twice the 800 px the sting shows, so no frame upscales them.
No play mark in the d, and no play mark beside the wordmark until the symbol and lockup gates close (nino, 2026-10-12). The traced play-d SVG this sting used before is removed.

LEGIBILITY-OVER-FOOTAGE: the mark is pure yellow #facc15 on transparent with a FLAT, zero-blur 6 px offset shadow in dark ink #111318 down and right, NEVER a soft glow. The shadow was an option until nino asked for it on 2026-10-12, after yellow lost contrast over white sky and a white board. It sits on each letter, not the word, so a fading letter fades with its own shadow instead of showing it through. 4 px thinned to a hairline at phone size; 10 px read as an extrusion. Do not bake in any other backing; the compositor owns placement.
Final delivery is ProRes 4444 MOV (alpha): a render-flag detail for the CLI, not a composition change.
shot_brief: A 5s transparent bookend sting for CapCut compositing over volleyball footage: the Peridot wordmark builds letter by letter, left to right, each letter growing in place with a small upward snap, holds flat and legible through the middle, then collapses letter by letter in the same direction. Frame 0 and the final frame are fully clear so it drops cleanly onto footage. Motion is the message; no tagline, no URL, no symbol. Rendered as an alpha overlay, final delivery ProRes 4444 MOV.
